info.bio:
Rihanna (Saint Michael, Barbados 20 de febrero de 1988 ) es el nombre artístico de Robyn Rihanna Fenty, una cantante barbadense. Su música tiene influencias de estilos como el reggae, R&B, dancehall y pop. Se ha hecho conocida en todo el mundo gracias a éxitos como Umbrella, We Found Love, Diamonds, Rude Boy y Work.

Nacida con el nombre de Robyn Rihanna Fenty en Saint Michael (Barbados), acudió a la Escuela Primaria Conmemorativa de Charles F.

mentions.author: Javier Blánquez (ed.)
mentions.text: …En cualquier caso, la canción que hizo bascular por completo el mundo del R&B al house y al trance fue «Only Girl (In the World)», el enésimo hit de Rihanna en apenas tres años. Poco antes, Robyn Fenty se había convertido en una estrella indiscutible del pop casi por accidente: el equipo de producción…

mentions.book: Loops 1 y 2. Una historia de la música electrónica
mentions.author: Javier Blánquez (ed.)
mentions.text: …trabajar —escribían habitualmente para Ciara, Britney Spears o Blu Cantrell—, pero Jay-Z y su equipo de Roc-a-Fella necesitaban algo especial para Rihanna, a la que había que moldear la carrera con urgencia, y pujaron por «Umbrella». En la primera escucha, «Umbrella» no parecía un hit inmediato —su construcción armónica era compleja—, pero tenía un gancho pegadizo en el estribillo y la buena genética de Rihanna hizo el resto para convertirla en la sensación del momento y condicionar su camino en el futuro. podcast.title: Musical Russian Nesting Dolls (2006)
podcast.body: Rihanna's 2006 number one hit "SOS" is described as "like musical Russian nesting dollars" because it was a remix of Soft Cell's cover, which itself was a cover of Gloria Jones's "Tainted Love," illustrating multiple layers of musical reinterpretation. "Rihanna's version of Soft Cells version of Gloria Jones was like musical Russian nesting dollars."

podcast.title: Income Plummet Due to Inactivity (2016)
podcast.body: Rihanna, an artist who typically ranked very high on income lists, saw her earnings plummet in 2016. This decline was directly linked to her decision not to release new material and not to tour during the year. "no sacar material y no girar, ha hecho que sus ingresos literalmente se desplomen."

podcast.body: A cigarette butt allegedly left behind by Rihanna was recovered and put up for sale on eBay with the caption, "Her Lips Touched It." The initial asking price for the item was $500. "Initial asking price? $500."

podcast.body: Rihanna is listed as a contemporary artist who has sold portions of her back catalog for a significant sum, aligning with a trend among successful musicians to monetize their entire body of work.

podcast.title: Embracing Dance Music with Eurodance Elements
podcast.body: Rihanna, an artist with roots in "black music," shifted her sound towards dance music, embracing a formula that exhibited structural similarities to Eurodance. This adaptation contributed to the genre's unexpected revival and subsequent chart success in the United States. "...Sorriana..."

srcs.episode: La gran mentira detrás del Eurodance

podcast.title: First Modern Artist in Top Sellers
podcast.body: Rihanna is identified as the first modern or very recent artist to rank among the top-selling artists in history. While her record label estimates her sales at approximately 230 million copies, independent organizations place her sales closer to 100 million copies.

srcs.episode: Qué es un disco de ORO?    cómo se concede?

podcast.title: Future Value of Vinyl
podcast.body: Rihanna's vinyl records, despite high sales, are predicted to have limited future value for collectors due to the nature of her fanbase, with expectations that these albums will become very inexpensive after 15-20 years. "tienes a Rihanna [...] el tipo de público que tienen estos artistas no es de coleccionista, no es de compradorexigente por cómo he evolucionado la historia de la música, este tipo de artistas tienden a acabar en las tanquetas 15, 20 años después de todo a un dólar."

podcast.title: Pop Dominance in 2010s
podcast.body: Rihanna was a significant artist during the period of pop music dominance that overshadowed rock by 2011-2012, as the genre gained increasing strength alongside hip hop and EDM. "And you can make the argument that it certainly did swamp by not only a rise in pop music, you know, Maroon 5, Justin Bieber, Rihanna, Pink Kitty Perry, Carly Recepcion, Adele, but also by the increasing strength of hip hop and the big beats and bass lines of EDM."

xref.title: Influenced by Grace Jones
xref.body: Madonna is among the notable artists whose work was influenced by Grace Jones, acknowledging Jones's powerful image and genre-blending style. This lineage demonstrates Jones's lasting impact on female artists who merge fashion, performance, and music. "Her influence extends not just to follow her, such as any Linux of the Arithmics, but all the way through Madonna, Lady Gaga, Rihanna, and Lord."

xref.title: Widespread Influence on Artists
xref.body: Grace Jones exerted a significant influence on a diverse range of artists, including Annie Lennox of Eurythmics, Madonna, Lady Gaga, Rihanna, and Lorde. Her impact extends to the drag queen and cross-dressing scene, solidifying her status as a powerful and transformative figure. "Her influence extends not just to follow her, such as any Linux of the Arithmics, but all the way through Madonna, Lady Gaga, Rihanna, and Lord."
